table-storage-account-key-pricing-differ.title: Account-scoped key Tables use different pricing
table-storage-account-key-pricing-differ.body: Tables encrypted with a key scoped to the storage account (needed for customer-managed keys) are priced on separate account-encrypted meters with per-operation-class rates, unlike default service-encrypted Tables.

citation.quote: Data storage and transaction pricing for account specific key encrypted Tables that relies on a key that is scoped to the storage account to be able to configure customer-managed key for encryption at rest
